notes:
• Layer blurs stay soft. After Effects 2026 switches "Repeat Edge Pixels" on
  for new Gaussian Blurs, which turned soft "Shadow" rectangles into hard-edged
  boxes – Framelift now switches it off. Groups' precomps also leave room for
  blurs and drop shadows inside them, so nothing gets cut off.
• Layer blurs are as soft as in Figma – the blur amount is now calibrated
  against real Figma and After Effects renders (it used to blur about twice
  as wide).
• Gradients that fade to transparent come in as native, editable After
  Effects layers: a Gradient Ramp for the colours plus a luma track matte
  for the transparency (2-stop linear, or radial from the centre). Others
  still use Figma's exact render.
• Bullet and numbered lists also keep exactly the line breaks Figma shows.
• All caps and small caps now come across. (After Effects only lets scripts
  set them through its newer caps setting – the old one silently did nothing.)
  Small caps set in Figma's Type details (OpenType) count too. All-caps text
  is also typed in capitals, so it always matches Figma.
• Second test frame (Figma plugin menu ▸ Create test frame): a pharma-style
  ad with soft blurred shadows, a Multiply overlay, a fade-to-transparent
  gradient, all caps, small caps, superscripts and an ISI tray with bullets
  and a nested numbered list – send it after every update to check.
• The Figma plugin is ready to publish to Figma Community (the live link to
  After Effects on this computer is declared the way Figma requires).
